'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[2026 Iran war]]
**[[2026 Iranian strikes on the United Arab Emirates]]
***The [[Ruwais refinery]] in [[Al Dhannah]], [[Abu Dhabi Emirate]], [[United Arab Emirates]], shuts down after a [[Unmanned aerial vehicles in the Iranian military|drone]] strike that causes a fire. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/fire-hits-site-housing-abu-dhabi-national-oil-company-operations-after-drone-2026-03-10/ (Reuters)]
**[[2026 Strait of Hormuz crisis]]
***[[United States]] intelligence sources report that [[Iran]] has started to deploy [[naval mine|underwater mines]] in the [[Strait of Hormuz]]. The [[United States Central Command|Central Command]] says that American forces have sunk several Iranian ships, including 16 minelaying vessels. [https://edition.cnn.com/2026/03/10/politics/iran-begins-laying-mines-in-strait-of-hormuz (CNN)] [https://www.cnbc.com/2026/03/11/us-strikes-iran-mine-ships-strait-of-hormuz-war-oil.html (CNBC)]
**[[United Kingdom involvement in the 2026 Iran war]]
***[[Royal Navy]] warship [[HMS Dragon (D35)|HMS ''Dragon'']] leaves [[Portsmouth]] and heads to [[Cyprus]] in response to a [[2026 drone strikes on Akrotiri and Dhekelia|drone strike]] on the [[United Kingdom]]'s [[RAF Akrotiri]] base. [https://www.bbc.com/news/live/cd70wzw9vqlt (BBC News)]
**According to [[Iran International]], [[United States Air Force|American]] and [[Israeli Air Force|Israeli]] airstrikes have killed many [[Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps]] commanders and generals, including [[Basij]] chief Asadollah Badfar. Prior to his reported death, Badfar was involved in [[2026 Iran massacres|crackdowns]] against the [[2025–2026 Iranian protests|2025–2026 protests]]. [https://www.iranintl.com/en/202603109175 (Iran International)] [https://www.jpost.com/middle-east/iran-news/article-889488 (''Jerusalem Post'')]
*[[Russo-Ukrainian war (2022–present)|Russo-Ukrainian war]]
**[[Attacks in Russia during the Russo-Ukrainian war (2022–present)|Attacks in Russia during the Russo-Ukrainian war]]
***Six people are killed and 37 others are injured in a [[Armed Forces of Ukraine|Ukrainian]] missile attack in [[Bryansk]], [[Russia]]. [https://english.news.cn/europe/20260311/2e7754e162b34c519b6fe6802e4c668d/c.html (Xinhua)]
**The [[Armed Forces of Ukraine|Ukrainian]] [[Special Operations Forces (Ukraine)|Special Operations Forces]] announce several overnight [[drone strikes]] on [[Russian Armed Forces|Russian]] [[electronic warfare]] stations and warehouses in [[Donetsk]] and [[Makiivka]], [[Donetsk Oblast]], [[Ukraine]]. [https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/03/10/8024805/ (''Ukrainska Pravda'')]
*[[Sudanese civil war (2023–present)|Sudanese civil war]]
**Forty people are killed in a drone strike on a truck carrying funeralgoers near [[Abu Zabad]], [[West Kordofan]], [[Sudan]]. [https://www.arabnews.com/node/2636082/middle-east (Arab News)]
**Seven people, including three children, are killed and 13 others are injured in a [[Rapid Support Forces]] drone strike in [[Dalang, South Kordofan|Dilling]], [[South Kordofan]], Sudan. [https://www.dailysabah.com/world/africa/3-children-among-7-killed-in-sudan-drone-attack-blamed-on-rsf (Daily Sabah)]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[2026 Strait of Hormuz crisis]], [[Economic impact of the 2026 Iran war]]
**The [[Price of oil|price]] of [[West Texas Intermediate]] [[crude oil]] rises by more than five percent to [[United States dollar|US$]]87.65 per barrel after [[United States]] [[President of the United States|president]] [[Donald Trump]] escalated threats related to the [[Strait of Hormuz]]. [https://www.spacewar.com/afp/260310225705.vmi1sjif.html (AFP via SpaceWar.com)]
**[[Thailand|Thai]] [[Prime Minister of Thailand|prime minister]] [[Anutin Charnvirakul]] orders [[remote work]] and the suspension of official international trips for [[Government of Thailand|government]] officials, and reduced [[Energy in Thailand|electricity]] use in government buildings amid supply concerns linked to the Iranian war. [https://www.reuters.com/business/energy/thailand-orders-bureaucrats-use-stairs-work-home-energy-saving-drive-2026-03-10/ (Reuters)]

[https://www.reuters.com/business/environment/indonesia-says-7-killed-landfill-collapse-rescue-operation-ends-2026-03-10/ (Reuters)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[Arctic sea ice decline]]
**The U.S. [[National Snow and Ice Data Center]] reports that [[Arctic ice pack|Arctic sea ice]] reached about 14.22 million square kilometers, which is among the lowest yearly high points recorded in more than four decades of [[Earth observation satellite|satellite monitoring]]. [https://www.rfi.fr/en/international-news/20260311-arctic-sea-ice-among-lowest-on-record-afp-review-of-us-data (AFP via RFI)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Australia–Iran relations]], [[Defection of Iran women's national football team]]
**[[Australia]] grants [[humanitarian visa]]s to five [[Iran women's national football team|Iranian women football]] players who sought [[Asylum in Australia|asylum]], including [[Captain (association football)|captain]] [[Zahra Ghanbari]], [[Mona Hamoudi]], [[Fatemeh Pasandideh]], [[Atefeh Ramezanizadeh]], and [[Zahra Sarbali]], citing fears of [[Human rights in the Islamic Republic of Iran|persecution]] after refusing to sing [[Mehr-e Khavaran|Iran's national anthem]] before an [[2026 AFC Women's Asian Cup|Asian Cup]] match in [[Gold Coast, Queensland|Gold Coast]], [[Queensland]]. **[[List of ministers of foreign affairs of the Netherlands|Dutch foreign minister]] [[Tom Berendsen]] announces the temporary relocation of staff and operations of the [[Netherlands]]' [[List of diplomatic missions of the Netherlands|embassy]] in [[Tehran]] to [[Baku]], [[Azerbaijan]], citing security risks to personnel amid the Iranian war. [https://english.alarabiya.net/News/world/2026/03/10/dutch-embassy-staff-in-tehran-to-move-to-azerbaijan- (AFP via Al Arabiya)]

**[[K27/28 Beijing-Dandong-Pyongyang through train|Train services]] between [[Beijing]], [[China]], and [[Pyongyang]], [[North Korea]], are announced to resume for the first time since it was suspended six years ago due to the [[COVID-19 pandemic]]. [https://apnews.com/article/vatican-pope-patriarch-cardinal-sako-aae178c5b95b765108c2fc76264c8eb6 (AP)] [https://www.vaticannews.va/en/vatican-city/news/2026-03/cardinal-sako-resigns-as-chaldean-patriarch-of-baghdad.html (Vatican News)]
*[[Madagascar|Malagasy]] [[Council of the Presidency for the Re-Foundation of the Republic of Madagascar|interim president]] and [[Madagascar Armed Forces|military]] leader [[Michael Randrianirina]] removes [[Prime Minister of Madagascar|prime minister]] [[Herintsalama Rajaonarivelo]] from power and dissolves the entire [[Cabinet of Madagascar|Cabinet]] without explanation, five months after they were assigned following the [[2025 Malagasy protests|2025 protests]].
